preflight.title: Before you begin
preflight.description: Please review the following information before starting the exam.
preflight.timePolicyUnlimited: No time limit (assignment mode), Answers auto-saved every 30 seconds
preflight.timePolicyAuto: Auto-submits when time expires, Answers auto-saved every 30 seconds
preflight.aiOnly: Only the platform's built-in AI may be used, External tools are not allowed
preflight.aiLogged: All AI conversations and activity are recorded and may be used in your evaluation
preflight.timePolicyUnlimitedBullet1: This is an assignment-mode exam with no time limit. Work at your own pace.
preflight.timePolicyUnlimitedBullet2: Answers are saved automatically. You can also save manually (Ctrl+S / Cmd+S).
preflight.timePolicyUnlimitedBullet3: When you are ready, click "Submit exam" to finish.
preflight.timePolicyBullet1: The timer starts when the instructor clicks "Start exam."
preflight.timePolicyBullet2: When time expires, your answers are submitted automatically and can no longer be edited.
preflight.timePolicyBullet3: Answers are saved automatically. You can also save manually (Ctrl+S / Cmd+S).
preflight.rulesBullet1: Do not switch to other browser tabs or applications during the exam.
preflight.rulesBullet2: Copy/paste activity is detected and may be flagged as academic dishonesty.
preflight.rulesBullet3: The AI chat feature is available, but all conversations are recorded.
preflight.rulesBullet4: Closing the page will not lose your answers. they are auto-saved. You can re-enter using the same exam code.
preflight.aiPolicyItem1Description: You are encouraged to use the Quest-ON AI Assistant during the exam.
preflight.aiPolicyItem2Title: External AI tools are not permitted
preflight.aiPolicyItem2Description: Using tools such as ChatGPT or Claude may result in your submission being voided.
preflight.aiPolicyItem3Description: Logical thinking, effective AI use, and critical analysis are the core evaluation criteria.
preflight.aiLogAlertDescription: All conversations with the AI during this exam are recorded automatically and may be used in your evaluation.
preflight.rulesCheckLabel: I have read and agree to follow the time policy and exam rules above.
preflight.aiLogCheckLabel: I understand that AI chat logs are recorded and will honestly indicate where I received AI assistance.
preflight.aiDisclosureAllowed: Stuck? Ask the AI. Asking is not cheating. it is part of the exam.
preflight.aiDisclosureGraded: What you ask is itself graded. Holding back questions works against you.
preflight.aiDisclosureVisible: Your conversation with the AI is shown to your instructor as-is.
